name: Frank Barajas
bio: Frank Barajas is a Ventura-born guitarist, singer and songwriter. He first made his name with the power-pop band Durango 95 and has recorded four studio albums, most recently The Third Man in 2015. Today he plays solo, in duos and with bands around Ventura County.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from Frank's Facebook and the Ojai Valley News.
